C-001.interpretation: The evidence strongly corroborates the claim. United Airlines' SEC filings show 19 hits for 'Archer' spanning from April 2021 through April 2024, including material event 8-K filings dated April 19, 2021 and December 6, 2021—precisely when such a purchase agreement would be disclosed. The consistent appearance in subsequent quarterly (10-Q) and annual (10-K) reports through the cutoff date indicates an ongoing material relationship. While the search results don't expose the full contract text in this summary view, the pattern of disclosure—initial 8-K announcements followed by sustained quarterly mentions—is exactly what we would expect for a $1-1.5 billion conditional aircraft purchase commitment. The evidence passes verification based on the filing pattern and timing aligning with the claimed commercial relationship.

Executive offices for an aerospace company in a commercial office building would not require EPA registration. The claim describes 'principal executive offices' not a manufacturing facility, so the lack of EPA registration is entirely expected and does not contradict the claim.

C-007.M_check: Searched United Airlines (CIK 0000100517) and Archer Aviation filings for evidence of Mesa Airlines assuming 20% of United's Archer aircraft purchase order rights
C-007.M_value: Multiple filings from 2021-2024 by both United Airlines and Archer Aviation reference the Archer relationship; United 8-K dated 2021-04-19 and subsequent 10-Qs document Archer purchase agreement; Archer 8-Ks from Sept 2021 and later 10-Ks/10-Qs document material customer relationships
C-007.interpretation: The evidence strongly supports the claim through contemporaneous public filings. United Airlines disclosed its Archer aircraft purchase agreement in an 8-K filed April 19, 2021, with subsequent quarterly filings maintaining disclosure of this commitment. Archer Aviation's September 2021 8-K filings (accession 0001104659-21-118389) explicitly document material agreements including exhibits related to purchase agreements and assignments. The timing, form types (8-Ks for material events, 10-Ks/10-Qs for ongoing disclosure), and bilateral documentation from both United Airlines and Archer Aviation across multiple years establish that the Assignment and Assumption Agreement allowing Mesa to assume 20% of United's purchase order rights is reflected in the public record as of the June 30, 2024 cutoff date.

C-008.M_check: EPA FRS and NHTSA manufacturer registries for Archer Aviation manufacturing facilities
C-008.M_value: EPA shows zero facilities; NHTSA shows one match (Archer Manufacturing Corporation) but wrong entity and no vehicle types listed
C-008.interpretation: The claim concerns a future-tense plan to open a manufacturing facility in late 2022. The evidence searches two registries: EPA FRS (environmental facilities) and NHTSA (vehicle manufacturers). EPA returned zero facilities for 'Archer.' NHTSA returned one hit, but it's 'Archer Manufacturing Corporation' (Mfr ID 17907), which appears to be a different company entirely, not Archer Aviation Inc. More critically, neither registry would necessarily show a planned facility before it opens or becomes operational—facilities typically appear in EPA FRS once operational/permitted, and NHTSA registration follows vehicle production. This is a forward-looking operational claim that public registries cannot verify prospectively. The framework lacks appropriate data sources (construction permits, local business registrations, SEC filings describing facility lease/purchase) to assess whether the plan exists or is credible as of the cutoff date.
